te: Preparations for the seminar on 20 November 2026 at the Rama Gardens Hotel
se: Representatives of King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior discussed preparations for the committee's seminar, to be held on Friday 20 November 2026, 08.00–16.00 hrs, at the Rama Gardens Hotel, Lak Si District, Bangkok, to build a shared understanding of the intent and mechanisms of the new facilitation law.
it: Preparing a seminar with King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior

te: Meeting summary video · Preparations for the seminar on 20 November 2026 at the Rama Gardens Hotel
Seminar preparations: held both on site and streamed live online
se: The meeting considered the seminar the committee is holding with King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior, both on site and streamed live online, for about 250 participants from government agencies at every level, the private sector and the public.
it: Seminar format, target group and activities

te: Meeting summary video · Seminar preparations: held both on site and streamed live online
Discussed the seminar details, with a focus on the work of the Ministry of Interior at the local level
se: A representative of King Prajadhipok's Institute discussed the details of the seminar, which aims to build understanding, assess readiness and study the gaps between the law and actual practice, by hearing central, provincial and local agencies, the private sector and service users.
it: Details of the seminar on Friday 20 November 2026

te: Meeting summary video · Discussed the seminar details, with a focus on the work of the Ministry of Interior at the local level
Approved a seminar project with King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior
se: The meeting considered a seminar on the readiness of the Ministry of Interior and related agencies, to build understanding of the intent of the law, assess readiness before the law takes effect, and gather problems from agencies and service users as policy proposals.
it: Seminar project and coordination with King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior

te: Meeting summary video · Approved a seminar project with King Prajadhipok's Institute, the OPDC and the Ministry of Interior
Discussed the seminar format with King Prajadhipok's Institute, 20 November 2026
se: A representative of King Prajadhipok's Institute discussed the approach for a seminar on preparing for and putting the facilitation law into practice. The key points are assessing the readiness of government agencies, hearing problems and obstacles, and developing proposals that can really be used. The morning has a keynote and a forum; the afternoon has 4 breakout groups.
it: Seminar format and programme, with King Prajadhipok's Institute

te: Forum topic set: putting the facilitation law into practice
se: The meeting set the topic and approach of a forum to prepare before the law takes effect on 4 January 2027, inviting policy agencies, agencies and state enterprises under the Ministry of Interior, the private sector and academic institutions. It will be held on Friday 20 November 2026, with about 250 participants.
it: Approach to the forum and the groups of participants

te: The Department of Provincial Administration explained its preparations under the new facilitation law
se: A representative of the Department of Provincial Administration said that the citizen's manuals cover about 228 services, and that time limits and documents are being reviewed, to be finished by December 2026, before the law takes effect on 4 January 2027. Some security-related services, such as registration, nationality and firearms, still need documents checked or identity confirmed.
it: Preparing citizen's manuals and the readiness of the Department of Provincial Administration

te: The Digital Government Development Agency gives information on central digital systems for public services
se: A representative of the Digital Government Development Agency (Public Organisation) explained its preparations and support for government agencies, data links and sharing between agencies, the electronic citizen's manual system, and the platform for applying and paying fees online, with problems and suggestions.
it: Central digital systems, data sharing, electronic citizen's manuals and cutting repeated requests for documents

te: Target agencies and questions for the study report decided
se: The meeting considered how to prepare the report, choosing target agencies under or supervised by the Ministry of Interior, such as the Department of Provincial Administration, the Department of Lands, the Department of Local Administration and the Provincial Electricity Authority, with questions on citizen's manuals, online services, the single main licence and fast-track channels.
it: Target agencies and 4 questions for gathering information

te: Study framework considered for a single main licence (Super License) for hotels
se: The Digital Government Development Agency and the Department of Provincial Administration asked to give their explanations at later meetings, so the meeting considered the study framework for a single main licence (Super License) for hotels, combining building inspection, fire protection and hygiene in one go, and agreed to invite the Department of Lands to give information on online services.
it: Study framework for a single main licence (Super License) for hotels, and the idea of joint inspection teams in the field
Information on the Department of Lands' online services (E-Service)

te: Approved 4 study measures and a study visit to Chiang Mai Province
se: The meeting approved preparing a study report focusing on agencies under the Ministry of Interior, on 4 measures: citizen's manuals, online services (E-Service), the single main licence (Super License) and fast-track service channels, and approved a study visit to Chiang Mai Province on 17–18 September 2026, to be reported to the committee for approval.
it: 4 study measures; the target group is the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration and municipalities
Study visit on agencies' readiness, Chiang Mai Province, 17–18 September 2026

te: Study outline considered, focusing on agencies under the Ministry of Interior
se: The meeting considered the study proposal on preparing to apply the Act on Facilitation of Licensing Consideration and Public Services B.E. 2569 (2026), studying only agencies under the Ministry of Interior over about 8 months, covering citizen's manuals, electronic services, the single main licence (Super License) and fast-track channels, with plans to visit 5 regions (may change).
it: Study outline: objectives, scope, study methods, lead and supporting agencies, and the readiness assessment framework
Site visit plan for the North, South, Central, East and Northeast regions
